title: China Repurposes 1M Nvidia Gaming Chips for AI Work
summary:
Domestic technology firms are using processors not originally intended for machine learning to address a severe shortage of high-end computing power. More than 1 million Nvidia gaming and workstation processors were repurposed for artificial intelligence work this year as demand for specialized accelerators far exceeds available supply.

The shift highlights an uphill battle for China to wean its tech industry off Nvidia's hardware, with companies snapping up products not designed for advanced AI to meet soaring requirements. This supply gap in computing hardware will remain until 2030.
